title: Charity does not decrease wealth
preview: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that giving in charity does not decrease one's wealth.
content:
# Charity does not decrease wealth

*Narrated by Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)*

The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said:

**"Wealth is not diminished by giving in charity."**

Allah replaces what we give and increases our provision when we spend in His cause. This hadith frees us from the fear of loss – so we can give with an open hand and a calm heart.

---

*Reference: Sahih Muslim*

title: Paradise lies at the feet of mothers
preview: The Prophet (SAW) said: "Paradise lies at the feet of mothers."
content:
# Paradise lies at the feet of mothers

*Narrated by Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)*

A man came to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and asked: **"Who among people is most deserving of my good companionship?"**

The Prophet said: **"Your mother."** The man asked again: "Then who?" The Prophet said: **"Your mother."** A third time: **"Your mother."** A fourth time: **"Your father."**

Three times the mother – then the father. It’s a reminder that never gets old: honour and serve your mother; the path to Paradise passes through her pleasure.

---

*Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 5971*

title: The best charity is that given in secret
preview: Among those shaded by Allah on the Day of Judgment: one who gives charity so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right has given.
content:
# The best charity is that given in secret

*Narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)*

The Prophet said: **"Seven people will be shaded by Allah on the Day when there will be no shade except His: a just ruler; a youth who grew up in the worship of Allah; a man whose heart is attached to the mosques; two men who love each other for the sake of Allah; a man who gives charity so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right hand has given..."**

Giving in secret purifies the intention – no show, no praise. It protects the one who receives. That’s the charity that draws closest to Allah.

---

*Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1423*

title: Seeking knowledge is an obligation
preview: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.
content:
# Seeking knowledge is an obligation

*Narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)*

The Messenger of Allah said: **"Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim."**

That means religious knowledge and any beneficial worldly knowledge. Learn, then teach. The one who walks a path seeking knowledge – Allah makes the path to Paradise easy for him.

---

*Reference: Sunan Ibn Majah 224*

title: A smile is charity
preview: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that smiling in the face of your brother is charity.
content:
# A smile is charity

*Narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)*

The Prophet said: **"Every good deed is charity. Among them: meeting your brother with a cheerful face, and pouring water from your bucket into your brother's vessel."**

You don’t need money to give. A smile, a kind word, a small help – all count. Start with your face; let it be a sadaqah every day.

---

*Reference: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 1970*

title: Cleanliness is half of faith
preview: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Cleanliness is half of faith."
content:
# Cleanliness is half of faith

*Narrated by Abu Malik al-Ash'ari (may Allah be pleased with him)*

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: **"Purity is half of faith."** (Or in another wording: *Cleanliness is half of faith.*)

Islam ties the inner state to the outer: ablution before prayer, washing, keeping body and place clean. It’s not vanity – it’s part of worship. Half of faith. Worth pausing on.

---

*Reference: Sahih Muslim 223*

title: Two blessings most people waste
preview: The Prophet (SAW) said that most people are at a loss regarding two great blessings: health and free time.
content:
# Two blessings most people waste

*Narrated by Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with him)*

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: **"There are two blessings that many people are deceived by: good health and free time."**

We think we’ll have both forever. Then health goes, or time fills up. The hadith doesn’t scold – it wakes us up. Use your health and your spare moments before they’re gone.

---

*Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6412*

title: Love for your brother what you love for yourself
preview: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
content:
# Love for your brother what you love for yourself

*Narrated by Anas (may Allah be pleased with him)*

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: **"None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself."**

Not “be nice” – **love for him what you love for yourself.** Success, safety, happiness, guidance. When that becomes natural, faith is real. It’s the golden rule of Islam.

---

*Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45*

title: Speak good or remain silent
preview: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
content:
# Speak good or remain silent

*Narrated by Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)*

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: **"Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent."**

Every word is either a good deed or a sin. So say what helps, comforts, or teaches – or say nothing. Silence is safe, and often wise. This one habit changes the quality of your life and your relationships.

---

*Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6475, Sahih Muslim 47*

title: The best of you are the best to their families
preview: The Prophet (SAW) said the best of you are those who are best to their families.
content:
# The best of you are the best to their families

*Narrated by Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her)*

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: **"The best of you are those who are best to their families, and I am the best of you to my family."**

Good character isn’t only for the mosque or the public. It starts at home – with parents, spouse, and children. The one who is kind and patient with his family is the one who is truly good in the sight of Allah.

---

*Reference: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3895*
